ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the copy-account button in a headless/permission-restricted browser triggers React dev-mode 'Uncaught runtime errors: Failed to execute writeText on Clipboard: Write permission denied.' overlay. The 'Copied' toast still fires regardless of success, so users on restricted browsers get a false-positive confirmation and see a dev error overlay. Suggest wrapping navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch and falling back to document.execCommand('copy') OR showing an error toast on rejection instead of the success one.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap clipboard writeText call in Deposit.jsx with try/catch: on rejection, show an error toast instead of the 'Copied' toast, and avoid throwing an uncaught promise rejection that surfaces the dev-mode error overlay.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1552 lines — the router-split refactor flagged in iterations 4 & 5 is still pending. Consider splitting admin_users, admin_deposits, deposit-create into separate routers.

admin_add_balance overdraft guard reads wallet_balance before the atomic $inc — safe under single-writer but has a theoretical race under concurrent admin debits. Acceptable for MVP but worth a comment.

create_deposit enrichment uses `payload.method.startswith('paynow')` to skip the payment-account lookup and then tries to oid() the method — if a manual method string happens to be exactly 24 hex chars it will accidentally be treated as a payment-account id. Extremely unlikely in practice but the guard could be tightened (e.g. only enrich when the string matches ObjectId pattern).

Admin get user response now stringifies FK fields, but the fix relies on `clean()` doing the top-level _id → id conversion; consider adding a defensive `d.pop('_id', None)` on the returned dict shape as a safety net.
Deposit.jsx clipboard copy handler shows 'Copied' toast regardless of writeText outcome, and doesn't catch the promise rejection — see UI bug above.
